description: Define the local state schema (StateFile): machine UUID, lastPolled per repo (Record<string, string>), seenCommentIds per repo (Record<string, number[]>). Generate machine UUID once on first run using crypto.randomUUID() and persist it. Implement atomic writes: write to state.json.tmp then rename. Implement otto.lock as an advisory lock to prevent two Otto processes running simultaneously on the same machine.
title: Local state model + machine UUID generation and persistence
